beware-claude-opus-4-1-retired-api-dead.title: Anthropic Just Killed Opus 4.1 — Your Agents Are Broken and Nobody Told You
beware-claude-opus-4-1-retired-api-dead.description: Claude Opus 4.1 was retired from the Anthropic API on August 5, 2026. Any hardcoded model ID now returns errors. Plus a hidden gotcha: passing temperature or top_p to Opus 4.7/4.8 returns HTTP 400. Here is how to diagnose what broke, what to migrate to, and how to avoid the silent failures hitting production agents right now.
